$comment: Licence gate for every package in pnpm-lock.yaml (THE-1738). `denied` are SPDX id prefixes; `*` matches the rest of the id. A package whose licence is missing or unreadable fails as unknown. `exceptions` map a package name to the reason it may ship anyway; each entry is a reviewed commit.

exceptions.@img/sharp-*: sharp's prebuilt platform binaries declare Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later for the bundled libvips; they run only at build time for Astro's image optimization and nothing from them is shipped to visitors
